## Recovered observations

20 points (from FC-12) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appc-b9`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: inset angle 43.07, tan theta .9349, cohesion 145.81; eight markers about 147, 734, 1761, 2345, 2934, 3815, 4400, 4695 psf; five match FC-4B stresses and peaks but avg density 58.00 against 58.7, so not that sheet alone; bound at PDF 148; Table 2-3 soil 6 is 61.4 pcf
- Codex: Computer fit; Avg. Density 58.00; phi 43.07; tan theta .9349; cohesion 145.81. Geometry and rate missing. Underlying test identities unresolved. Density and point count differ from candidate data sheets. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. C-12, printed C-34, PDF 148
